dct_description_sm: Sustainable harvesting of game populations and the corresponding determination of hunting quotas require reliable information on the size and development of game populations. Continuous monitoring of game populations is an important task of the Finnish Game and Fisheries Research Institute. Reliable information on game abundance and the annual game bag benefits both hunting and scientific research. More than 30 game species are monitored.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Hunting
dct_title_s: Monitoring wildlife richness: Finnish applications based on wildlife triangle censuses
